name: Hypershot (0.1)
author: liu630moon
description: You are an agent who snuck into an enemy base controlled by robots. The base is challenging, with sticky walls, long parkour, hidden caverns, laser-robot traps, and more! The organization you work for has already given you a helicopter to get in the base, a starting-weapon, a jetpack, two appliable weapons, and three disguised healing bots deployed in the main lobby. The entire base is a maze, and you must finish your mission without dying. Every once in a while, you will land in a different base or have different levels needed to be finished. Good luck, agent!
